statement.zh: 郑州铜器窖藏只能解释为战乱紧急窖藏。
statement.en: Zhengzhou bronze hoards can only be explained as emergency wartime caches.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: ritual deposition vs. emergency cache (and mixed) readings remain open; the 1999 report documents finds, not a single forced function.
